name: Pre-computed Covariance and Color Buffer Generation
definition: A preprocessing step that converts raw Gaussian splat parameters (position, scale, rotation, color) into pre-computed 3x3 covariance matrices and normalized float colors to accelerate rendering. It solves the problem of per-frame matrix multiplication and color decoding by computing these values once during load.
summary: Pre-computed Covariance and Color Buffer Generation is a preprocessing step that converts raw Gaussian splat parameters into pre-computed covariance matrices and normalized colors to accelerate rendering by reducing GPU compute overhead.
